info.title: ffp-agent-verify
info.description: Verify and risk-score automated frequent-flyer award searches. See docs/ for integration guides.

post.description:
Verify one incoming award search. Returns allow / flag / challenge / throttle / block.

Act on `decision`; show `reasons` to the tool (they're written for tool developers).

put.description: Replace the airline authorization server's signing keys (JWKS).
Replace the airline's policy. Takes effect on every replica within ~1s, no redeploy.

patch.description: Merge a partial policy (e.g. `{"max_searches_per_min_per_credential": 20}`) into the current one.

get.description: Decision mix, top reasons, latency, riskiest tools and recent risk events for this airline.

post.description: Revoke one member's authorization of a tool at this airline (credential revocation).
Register a tool's Ed25519 public key. `proof` shows the caller holds the private key.

get.description:
Public: the tool's current key(s). Airline authorization servers use this for private_key_jwt
client authentication and to check the `dpop_jkt` they bind tokens to.

post.description: Revoke a tool's key everywhere (key compromise, or confirmed abuse).

get.description: The tool's risk profile: decisions, reasons, riskiest grants and the quotas it must respect.

put.description:
The airline's own redemption inventory feed: seats open vs. the cap, per flight, date and award class.

Upserts by (operating carrier, flight, date, award class). Include partner / alliance space with
`operating_carrier`. Older snapshots never overwrite newer ones.

get.description:
The redemption catalog for this program: departure, destination, date, cabin, award class and
seats available vs. total, including partner space. `summary` totals seats per cabin and class.

post.description:
An authorized tool reports the award availability its searches returned at `airline_id`.

Only tools with an active member authorization at that airline (one that has made a verified search
there) may report. `seats_total` is optional; the last
known cap is kept when it's missing.
Label a decision (false positive / negative, confirmed abuse / legitimate) for tuning.

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Shown once. Send as X-Api-Key on /v1/search/verify.

max_searches_per_min_per_credential.title: Max Searches Per Min Per Credential

max_searches_per_min_per_tool.title: Max Searches Per Min Per Tool

max_searches_per_min_per_ip_unauthentica.title: Max Searches Per Min Per Ip Unauthenticated

webdriver.title: Webdriver
webdriver.description: navigator.webdriver from the airline's client script

url.title: Url
url.description: Full URL exactly as the tool requested it (scheme, host, path, query)

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: All request headers; must include Authorization, Signature-Input and Signature for signed requests

body_b64.title: Body B64
body_b64.description: Request body, base64, if the signature covers content-digest

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: Ignored because a newer observation already exists

operating_carrier.title: Operating Carrier
operating_carrier.description: Defaults to the program's own airline (own metal)

seats_total.title: Seats Total
seats_total.description: Redemption cap for this class on this flight

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: When this snapshot was taken; defaults to now

pillar.title: Pillar
pillar.description: Which layer this signal belongs to (docs/framework.md)

public_jwk.title: Public Jwk
public_jwk.description: Ed25519 public key as an OKP JWK

management_token.title: Management Token
management_token.description: Shown once. Send as X-Tool-Token for analytics and revocation.

pillars.title: Pillars
pillars.description: The score split across safety / trust / verifiability (sums to score); a failed hard check puts 100 on its own layer. Null when degraded.

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: True if Redis was unavailable and the airline's fail mode applied
